Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner shifted the comparison to an edge-case “per-location at the poles,” asserting sunrise occurs only about once per year there, and then concluded that full moons are more frequent. The question implies a general comparison, where sunrise occurs daily (at most locations and continuously somewhere on Earth), far more frequently than full moons, equinoxes, or solar eclipses. This misframing of criteria led to the wrong final answer.
